title: Sughra My Qafila Laayi Hu.
body:
Sughra my qafila laayi hu….
Kunbe ko khokar aayi hu….
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Jo aale nabi par sitam hua my kaise bataau tujhe
Ye neel rasan ke shaano par my kaise dikhaau tujhe
Har zakhm jigar par khaayi hu….
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Naazo ke pale bache pyaare sab ran me maare gaye
Qaime se gaye jo bhi ran ko wo laut ke na aaye
Abid ko bachaakar laayi hu….
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Baba tera paani ki qaatir tadpaakar maaragaya
Shabbir ka sookha gala tera zarbon se kaata gaya
My kuch bhi nahi kar paayi hu….
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bhaayi bhi nahi bete bhi nahi tanha thi my moqtal me…
Akbar ke jigar me thi barchi kuffar ke jangal me
Deewaron se sar takraayi hu…..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ummat ne reham khaaye hi nahi nhanne se asgar par
Tha nhanna chaand sa sar sughra naize par qoon me tar
Ye dekhke my gash khaayi hu….
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Qaime me bhi jalaaye the zaalim ham hogaye bechaadar
Beaas hui thi soya tha ghazi mera dariya par
Baalon se chehra chipaayi hu…
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Baazar gayi thi nange sar ay sughra aale abi
Jakde the rasan se haathon ko har bibi bani qaidi
Kya kya na sitam my uthaayi hu….
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Sheh ki judaayi seh na saki zindaan me ghutghut kar
Sadma na utha dam tod gayi ay sughra teri qaahar
Zindaa me use chod aayi hu…..
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Laakhon ka majma tha sughra aur my thi tamaashayi
Sunta hi nahi tha koi mera my bas ye kehti thi
Zehra ki  my jaayi hu…..
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Zaalim ne jalaaya tha sughra beemaar ka bhi bistar
Durre bhi lage barse kode sughra tere bhai par
Ye manzar dekh ke aayi hu….
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Althaf-o-Asghar  aise kaho har aankh ho ashk se tar
Kehti thi ahle madeena se Zainab ye rorokar
My zinda kyu laut aayi hu….
